budget_items.topic: Director's report: formula grant funds for instructors
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director will use FY2019 formula grant funds to pay instructors for pickle ball, Zumba, and a new program called Nirvana; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: she will use formula grant funds for fiscal year 2019 to focus on paying instructors for pickle ball, zumba, and a new program called nirvana.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finishing of the shuffleboard court is in progress; a contractor was found to finish it for a stated price.
budget_items.quote: dave dorren of the supporters has found someone to finish it for $850.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DPW contacted three people to paint the walkway; cost to be covered by Formula Grant funds; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the cost will be covered by formula grant funds.

budget_items.topic: Gordon Edes event fundraiser for Jimmy Fund
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Gordon Edes raised money for the Jimmy Fund in his father's name.
budget_items.quote: he was able to raise $300 for the jimmy fund in his father's name.

budget_items.topic: Eagle House Supporters fundraising (World Series trophy and ticket raffle)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: About $4,000 was raised for the Supporters from the World Series trophy and a raffle of four tickets behind home plate at Fenway Park.
budget_items.quote: about $4,000 was raised for the supporters.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The cookout is paid for by the Eagle House Supporters; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the event is paid for by the eagle house supporters.
